prompts.cat: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production transparent RGBA mascot sprite for the Fangcun iOS breathing app. Reference image is the approved original character identity and printmaking style, NOT a layout to copy. Draw ONLY the CAT, full body, in a naturally continuous beautiful silhouette, a relaxed seated three-quarter pose slightly facing right. Cute plump cream-white cat, rounded triangular ears, the right ear has a muted terracotta-orange patch, tiny round deep muted blue eyes, small simple smiling mouth, two short whiskers on each cheek, a curled tail connected to the rump on the left. Short gently curved front legs rest naturally on the ground, small rounded paws; body broad and soft, NO pinched neck, NO oversized pasted-on floating head, NO separate oval belly, NO detached parts, no seams. Head and torso share continuous outer contour, just like the approved original. Face remains near front view and subtly curious. Body cream is fully opaque and uniform, not a gradient. Muted indigo blue #2E5185 slightly irregular thick linocut outline with restrained tiny dry-print gaps, warm white flat fill #FFFDF5, orange #E58A6E only one ear. No shadows, no 3D, no human anatomy, no props, no text, no borders, no background paper. A SINGLE intact character, fills about 80 percent of square canvas height, full tail and all paws visible, 10 percent transparent margins. This sprite will be animated through tiny LOCAL belly expansion; preserve coherent anatomy, broad chest below head and stable feet. Transparent background.
prompts.dog: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent RGBA mascot sprite for Fangcun iOS breathing app. Reference image: approved original linocut cat/dog identity. Draw ONLY the DOG, full body in a relaxed seated three-quarter pose, slightly facing left but face near front. A sweet plump little puppy, low and rounded with natural canine silhouette and broad shoulders, two short rounded front paws resting together on ground, one side haunch, a short upward curved orange tail attached to rump on right. Small face set into the soft rounded head, tiny indigo dot eyes and little simple navy nose and gentle w-shaped smile. TWO DROOPY EARS fully connected to the sides of head; left ear warm-white with blue outer outline, right ear muted terracotta orange. Ears hang down close against head, no floating detached ears, no lamb-like curly top, no poodle wool, no pinched thin neck, no snowman body, no giant bobblehead. Head-to-body flows naturally, neck almost invisible. Identity same sleepy puppy as original reference but sitting. Muted indigo blue #2E5185 hand carved slightly uneven thick line with subtle dry-print texture; opaque warm-white #FFFDF5 flat body; muted orange #E58A6E on right ear and short tail. No shadows, 3D, gradients, accessories, props, mat, text, separate parts. One intact beautifully coherent animal with a stable grounded silhouette. Fits in square canvas with 10 percent transparent margins, all ears feet and tail visible. Transparent background.
prompts.rest: Create a single full-body transparent RGBA mascot sprite. Reference 1 is the newly designed Fangcun puppy: preserve exactly its simple tiny face, muted indigo thick slightly grainy linocut outline, opaque cream-white body and terracotta-orange right drooping ear and small tail. Reference 2 is the approved original design identity. Draw this SAME puppy in a natural resting PRONE pose, face on left, body extends to right. Chin rests gently on two rounded front paws; face is softly smiling with two tiny CLOSED crescent eyes; drooping orange ear attached continuously to right side of head, other ear attached naturally on left. Body broad rounded low horizontal loaf; hind leg folded gently under right haunch, tiny orange tail near rump. Whole outline connected and anatomically coherent; no floating ear, no separately pasted head, no pinched neck, no pillow, no blanket, no ground shadow, no mat, no props, no text. Flat clean opaque warm-white fill and only restrained print texture within blue contours and orange ear. No 3D, gradients or glossy rendering. Entire character centered in a landscape canvas with generous transparent margins, occupies 80 percent width. The torso on right will be gently animated while chin and feet remain fixed. One complete cute calm sleepy puppy, transparent background.
prompts.meditation: Create a transparent full body sprite of EXACTLY the cat in the reference, same silhouette proportions, colors, lines, curled tail and paw positions. Change only expression and pose very slightly for quiet meditation: both eyes softly closed as small navy curved lines, tiny calm smile, front paws relaxed and planted. Preserve one continuous rounded head/body contour with no neck seam or pasted parts. Tiny terracotta-orange patch on right ear, cream-white opaque body, muted indigo blue hand carved outline and restrained dry print texture. No props, no text, no shadows, no background, no effects. Single complete seated cat, all paws tail ears visible, centered within square transparent canvas with 10 percent margins. The entire original anatomy must remain coherent. Flat colors, no 3D, gradients or shiny light.
prompts.side: Use case: precise-object-edit. Take the puppy in the attached image, keep its exact blue printmaking outline, white flat opaque body, attached droopy ears and orange ear/tail. Change the pose from seated to lying comfortably on its side. Draw the paws softly bent, the front paw rests along lower ribs; head on left, rump on right. Eyes open softly, small friendly smile. Keep the outline clean solid blue, the shapes flat, ZERO blur, zero glow, zero shadow or aura. One sharp-edged simple flat sticker on transparent background, no scenic elements. Square canvas, puppy centered and fully inside canvas with generous transparent margins. No text. Natural connected anatomy, no detached pieces, no floating limbs. Preserve the handmade print style exactly, no special effects.
prompts.coach: Edit the supplied Fangcun dog mascot into a gentle little exercise coach. Preserve EXACTLY its complete silhouette, white cream fill, indigo-blue linocut outline, orange attached floppy right ear, short orange tail, tiny eyes and smiling mouth. Change only the front paw on the left side of the image: bend it slightly upward and have it naturally grasp a short little BLUE FLAG pole. The flag is small, placed left of the body at chest height, clearly connected to the paw holding it, not floating. Other front paw and haunch stay grounded, full-body seated dog remains relaxed. No muscle strain, no head-body seams, no detached ears, no extra limbs. Actual blue flag fabric and simple short stick with no text. Entire dog including flag fits a square canvas with transparent margins. Flat clean 2D cream body, gently textured blue contour, no shadows, no glow, no blur, no 3D, no gradient. Transparent background.
